message: You know, there’s something almost comedic about the chaos that ensues when a storm sneaks up on us. I once found myself trying to locate all the candles while my cat thought it was the perfect time to hide under the couch. 🙃 Having a plan and knowing what to do can turn that frantic search into a calm evening with a good book (and maybe a flashlight). Have you ever had a storm catch you off guard? What’s your go-to strategy?
